dates: (d.23 Oct 1895)
---

contributor to MP (1871-93)

Daughter of the 1st Lord Brabourne, she was at Newnham College, Cambridge, 1883-6 and served as Librarian 1894-5. Some of her papers are in the Centre for Kentish Studies. [Margaret Wilson, A Kent Girl-Graduate (1994)]
